theorem lg_target : LawfulMonad PMF := by
  unfold LawfulMonad
  -- Left identity: pure a >>= f = f a
  intro α β a f
  dsimp [bind, pure]
  ext x
  simp [PMF.bind, PMF.pure]
  split
  · simp [PMF.bind, PMF.pure]
  · simp [PMF.bind, PMF.pure]
  -- Right identity: m >>= pure = m
  intro α m
  dsimp [bind, pure]
  ext x
  simp [PMF.bind, PMF.pure]
  -- Associativity: (m >>= f) >>= g = m >>= (λ x, f x >>= g)
  intro α β γ m f g
  dsimp [bind]
  ext x
  simp [PMF.bind]
  rw [← bind_assoc]
  simp [PMF.bind]
  rw [bind_assoc]
  simp [PMF.bind]
  refl
